description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the auditing functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It verifies that audit records are correctly created for different actions like creating, closing, and reactivating clients and offices, as well as testing search templates, limit parameters, and order-by support.

classes.name: AuditIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains JUnit 5 test methods to validate audit trail functionalities such as creating, updating, and querying audit records in the Fineract system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the REST Assured client setup, authentication headers, and auxiliary helpers before each test execution.

methods.name: testAuditSearchTemplate
methods.description: Verifies the audit search template contains expected fields like appUsers, actionNames, entityNames, processingResults.

methods.name: auditShouldbeCreated
methods.description: Performs create/update actions on clients and offices, then verifies corresponding audit records are created correctly.

methods.name: checkAuditsWithLimitParam
methods.description: Tests audit retrieval with limit parameters to ensure pagination or limit filtering works as expected.

methods.name: checkIfOrderBySupported
methods.description: Checks if various fields are supported for ordering results in audit search queries.
